name: UTM Link Creator & QR Code Generator
description: Creates UTM links, generates QR codes, and schedules Google Analytics reports.

nodes.label: Schedule Google Analytics Report To Marketing Manager

inputs.system:
"You are an advanced data analytics AI specializing in executive reporting. Your task is to analyze the provided dataset and generate a structured executive summary that highlights key insights, trends, and actionable takeaways. Structure your summary in the following format:

Overview - Briefly describe the dataset and its significance.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) - Highlight the most important metrics and compare them to previous periods if applicable.
Trends & Insights - Identify patterns, growth areas, declines, and anomalies.
Opportunities & Recommendations - Provide strategic recommendations based on the insights.
Conclusion - Summarize the key takeaways concisely.
*Ensure the tone is professional, clear, and tailored for executives who require quick, data-driven insights without unnecessary details."

setup: Setup value recipientEmail: Recipient email address (for example you@example.com). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value airtableBaseId: Airtable base id (for example appXXXX (from the base URL)). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value airtableTableId: Airtable table id (for example tblXXXX (from the table URL)). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
After import, start the schedule: cdecli cron activate utm-link-creator-qr-code-generator.

triggers.node: Create UTM Link & Send To Database
Schedule Google Analytics Report To Marketing Manager

hints: "Google Analytics Data Analysis Agent" kept conversation memory (memoryBufferWindow); sessionId is set to the run-input sessionId.

"Google Analytics Data Analysis Agent" used agent tools in the original: Google Analytics (googleAnalyticsTool). The cdecli agent calls connectors directly; connect credentials for the services those tools reached. Prefer connectors: google-analytics.
"Submit UTM Link To Database" (record.upsert): Airtable upsert without id → CREATE_RECORD (no match-key upsert).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect airtable: `cdecli credential create -n "airtable" -p airtable --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect google-analytics: `cdecli credential create -n "google-analytics" -p google-analytics --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
Create a marketing link with UTM parameters. Easily store in database and have QR code created and ready as well.

Type in requirements:
website URL
campaign id
campaign source
campaign medium
campaign name
campaign term

Code node creates the URL with UTM parameters. 

It then sends to your Airtable database to store for records. It also creates a QR code with the embedded link to be used for materials. 

Sample Airtable Setup:
-Website Link UTM column

Schedule a Google Analytics Reports with Medium/Source to track UTM link performance. Update the reporting fields to fit your business needs. You can track traffic, conversions and other engagement metrics.

*Sample Google Report Metrics: Sessions. Update metrics as needed.
